note: Realistic filled-in states in the scoring engine's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. The pre-analytical axis is clock-derived (hoursSinceCollection uses Date.now()) for a *collected* specimen with a timestamp, so every persona here either leaves the specimen not-yet-collected (deterministic 'ok', immune to rot) or uses a collection date-time far enough in the past that it stays in the same band indefinitely (elapsed time only grows) — never a date chosen to land in the narrow 24–48h 'ageing' caution window, which a fixed timestamp would drift out of.

personas.name: two-week-wait-breast-lump-fna-timing-unconfirmed
personas.description: New palpable breast lump: FNA of breast is first-line for breast-lump, and the indication itself meets NICE NG12 two-week-wait eligibility regardless of requested urgency; the specimen was collected but its date-time was never recorded, forcing a deterministic pre-analytical caution (verify timing/fixation) rather than the fresh 'ok' band — expect usually-appropriate + caution + two-week-wait + accept.

request.clinicalQuestion: New 2cm firm, irregular, painless lump in the right breast noticed 3 weeks ago — exclude malignancy.
request.clinicalDetails: No nipple discharge or skin changes. No family history of breast cancer.

triage.notes: FNA performed in the one-stop breast clinic; collection time not logged on the request form.

Specimen collected but collection date-time is missing — confirm timing and fixation.
Breast lump — NICE NG12 suspected-cancer two-week-wait pathway.

flags.suggestedAction: Route on the NICE NG12 two-week-wait suspected-cancer pathway; do not delay for routine booking.

personas.name: suspected-malignancy-sputum-stale-specimen-incomplete
personas.description: Suspected lung malignancy: sputum cytology is first-line, and the indication meets NICE NG12 two-week-wait eligibility, but the specimen was collected long before the request was submitted — well past the pre-analytical window — forcing a reject-risk band (redirect / recollect), and several administrative fields are not yet captured — expect usually-appropriate + reject-risk + two-week-wait + redirect, completeness below 100.

triage.notes: Specimen collected at an earlier appointment before the referral pathway was finalised; recollection likely needed.
